en.description: Establish a runnable failure signal before investing in root-cause hypotheses.
en.scenario: Debug a validator that intermittently accepts blank emails.
en.mechanism: A concrete feedback signal lets hypotheses predict an observable result.
en.bad: Read many files, guess a root cause and patch it without reproducing.
en.good: Build one command that supplies blank-email fixtures and asserts rejection. Run it and capture the actual failure; for a flake pin seeds or record reproduction rate. Only then form falsifiable hypotheses and rerun the same signal after each change.
en.why: A concrete feedback signal lets hypotheses predict an observable result.
en.expected: The recorded command fails on the reported symptom and passes after the relevant fix.
en.boundaries: When reproduction is impossible, report access or evidence gaps; do not claim a diagnosis by intuition.

zh.description: 投入根因假设前，先建立可运行失败信号。

zh.mechanism: 具体反馈信号让假设能预测可观察结果。
zh.bad: 读很多文件、猜根因，未经复现就打补丁。
zh.good: 建立一个提供空白邮箱夹具并断言拒绝的命令。运行并捕获实际失败；偶发问题固定 seed 或记录复现率，再提出可证伪假设，每次修改后复用同信号。
zh.why: 具体反馈信号让假设能预测可观察结果。
zh.expected: 所记命令对报告症状失败，相关修复后通过。
zh.boundaries: 无法复现时报告访问或证据缺口，不靠直觉声称已诊断。

en.description: Use static tracing for unsafe execution and state the runtime evidence it cannot supply.
en.scenario: Review a script that opens a production browser session and submits changes.
en.mechanism: Static evidence answers bounded questions without triggering external effects.
en.bad: Run it to see what happens, or claim static reading proves runtime success.
en.good: Do not execute the production script. Trace input values, branches, command arguments and destinations; compare to expected behavior. Check safe syntax separately if available. Report analyzed paths and list runtime auth, network and UI behavior as unverified.
en.why: Static evidence answers bounded questions without triggering external effects.
en.expected: The report distinguishes traced properties from unexecuted behavior.
en.boundaries: Static tracing can miss dynamic evaluation; use a safe sandbox when available and authorized.

zh.description: 执行不安全时做静态追踪，并说明无法提供的运行证据。
zh.scenario: 评审会打开生产浏览器并提交修改的脚本。
zh.mechanism: 静态证据回答有限问题，不触发外部效果。

zh.good: 不执行生产脚本。追踪输入、分支、命令参数、目标，并与期望比较；可用时另做安全语法检查。报告分析路径，把运行认证、网络、UI 行为列为未验证。
zh.why: 静态证据回答有限问题，不触发外部效果。
zh.expected: 报告区分已追踪性质与未执行行为。
zh.boundaries: 静态追踪可能遗漏动态求值；有可用且获准沙盒时使用。

en.description: Record an architectural decision when reversal cost, missing context and trade-off all matter.
en.scenario: Choose a durable storage model after comparing two approaches.
en.mechanism: Three gates reserve decision records for choices future maintainers need to understand.
en.bad: Write an ADR for every renamed variable and every obvious default.
en.good: Write an ADR for choosing append-only storage if changing it later is costly, future readers would not understand the choice, and alternatives had real trade-offs. Record context, alternatives and consequences. Put routine defaults in ordinary documentation.
en.why: Three gates reserve decision records for choices future maintainers need to understand.
en.expected: The ADR explains a meaningful rejected alternative and the chosen consequence.
en.boundaries: The gates are editorial heuristics; required compliance records may use different criteria.

zh.description: 逆转成本、缺失背景与真实取舍都重要时，记录架构决定。

zh.why: 三道门把决定记录留给后续维护者需要理解的选择。
zh.expected: ADR 解释有意义的被拒方案与所选后果。
zh.boundaries: 三道门是编辑启发式；合规要求的记录可能采用不同判据。

en.description: Make uncertain requirements and competing interpretations explicit before an irreversible choice.
en.scenario: Implement an export request whose audience, fields and delivery destination are unspecified.
en.mechanism: Inspect what is known, list the consequential unknowns, present plausible interpretations and resolve only the decisions that change the implementation.
en.bad: Assume all records, every field and a public file destination without telling the user.
en.good: State the unresolved export scope and sensitive-field choice; offer concrete supported interpretations; use the selected scope in implementation.
en.why: The decision-maker sees choices that would otherwise be silently invented.
en.expected: The resulting requirement record names chosen scope, fields and destination, with assumptions distinguished from facts.
en.boundaries: Explore discoverable facts first; trivial settled details do not require an interview.

zh.good: 指出导出范围与敏感字段尚未确定，给出具体可行解释，并按选定范围实现。
zh.why: 决策者能看到原本可能被默默虚构的选择。

zh.boundaries: 先探索可查事实；已明确的琐碎细节无需反复询问。

en.description: Defer speculative features and abstractions until a concrete requirement justifies them.
en.scenario: Add one percentage-discount calculation to an existing service.
en.mechanism: Implement the actual calculation with its required input rules, and introduce strategy/configuration layers only when a real use case needs them.
en.bad: Add multiple strategy classes, plugin configuration and notifications for one requested percentage calculation.
en.good: Add a small percentage calculation with required validation; leave other discount modes outside this task.
en.why: The implementation complexity has a traceable reason.
en.expected: Every introduced feature or abstraction corresponds to a present requirement.
en.boundaries: Necessary safety, validation and existing architectural contracts still apply; fewer lines alone is not success.

en.description: Bound authorized edits to the requested behavior and only clean up orphans created by those edits.
en.scenario: Fix empty-email handling in a validator with unrelated username logic.
en.mechanism: Change the email defect, retain surrounding style and behavior, remove only newly unused code and report unrelated findings separately.
en.bad: Fix email handling while reformatting the whole file and tightening username policy.
en.good: Change the empty-email path; keep username rules and formatting; remove only the import made unused by this fix.
en.why: The diff preserves nearby behavior outside the authorized change.
en.expected: Every changed line is explained by the request or a direct consequence of the fix.
en.boundaries: Necessary cross-file changes are allowed when causally required; this is a bounded-write rule, not a read-only prohibition.

zh.description: 将已授权编辑限定在请求行为内，只清理本次编辑产生的孤立代码。

zh.good: 只改空邮件路径，保留用户名规则与格式，仅移除因本次修复不再使用的导入。
zh.why: 差异保留授权变更范围之外的相邻行为。
zh.expected: 每条修改都能由请求或修复的直接结果解释。
zh.boundaries: 因果上必要的跨文件修改允许进行；这是有界写入规则，不是只读禁止。

en.description: Translate vague actions into observable success criteria and verify each meaningful step.
en.scenario: Fix sessions remaining active after a password change.
en.mechanism: State the invalidation behavior, reproduce it with a failing oracle, implement the change and verify that the same oracle plus relevant regressions pass.
en.bad: Review and improve authentication with no named failing behavior or check.
en.good: Specify old-session rejection after password change; demonstrate failure first; implement invalidation; run that check and relevant session regressions.
en.why: The loop terminates on evidence of the desired behavior rather than a narrative of activity.
en.expected: The verification records show the stated defect before the change and the intended behavior after it.
en.boundaries: The oracle must detect the defect; source tie-order examples checking only scores do not establish tied-identity order.

zh.description: 把模糊动作转成可观察成功条件，并验证有意义的步骤。

zh.mechanism: 明确会话失效行为，用失败判据复现，再实现修改并验证原判据及相关回归通过。
zh.bad: 没有指明失败行为或检查，就泛泛审查和改善认证。
zh.good: 指定改密码后旧会话被拒绝，先展示失败，再实现失效逻辑，运行该检查和相关会话回归。
zh.why: 循环依据目标行为的证据结束，而非活动叙述。
zh.expected: 验证记录展示修复前的缺陷与修复后的预期行为。
zh.boundaries: 判据必须检出缺陷；来源中仅检查分数的同分排序示例不能验证身份次序。
